request.text: A VBScript on pgustavo's desktop launched an encoded PowerShell that is beaconing out from WORKSTATION5. Stop process 2316 (powershell.exe) on WORKSTATION5.theshire.local.

package.rationale: pgustavo ran C:\Users\pgustavo\Desktop\launcher.vbs with wscript.exe, which opened and started powershell.exe PID 2316; that PowerShell connects to 10.10.10.5:80 and ran whoami. A VBScript launcher started a beaconing PowerShell implant; stop PID 2316 now.
